title: MZ Need help with a custom combat plugin

posts.author: Picsney
posts.body:
I want to modify the way Tactical Points work ; as of now, I want to make it so that their maximum value is 3, and hitting an enemy with a basic attack gives you 1 TP (and this is the only way to gain TP, for example taking damage from enemies doesn't work anymore)
With the code I have here, everything works perfectly :
Now I want to make it so that TPs are shared between allies : if an ally uses 1 TP to do something, all allies lose 1 TP as well, and if an ally gains 1 TP, the others gain it too, etc.
I've been trying to implement this for over an hour, without success. The code I have (and my other tries) were generated by ChatGPT as I barely have any experience in programming, but I just can't make it work, so I was wondering if anyone could help.
Here is one of my failed codes, just in case it can help :

posts.author: Coolie
posts.body: While I don't have RPG Maker MZ, the plugin YEP_PartyLimitGauge for MV sounds like a better solution to what you want to achieve, since you want a resource to be shared between all battle members. If there is something similar available to MZ users, I would use that.

far safer than modify the core files.
@Picsney
listen to the others, like Robro33 as a plugin is 10x safer and
they know what they do as MV wont work in MZ (most part) without FOSSIL.
but most try to stay away when not needed, as there are MZ plugins that
could help you or a snippet that others can make
